name: InputRecordTimer
evidence: timer callback; every 4th tick pushes 0x12-byte record (4 slot dwords + ticks) into ring of 5

name: HandleSlotButtons
evidence: reads the 4 slot dwords; bit0 pause, bit1 replay, bits10-13/14-17 line change per team, bits18/19 goalie pull

name: RunSimFrames
evidence: runs n sim frames after HandleSlotButtons; stops on menu request

name: PollControllers
evidence: fills 4-entry slot table (7 bytes each) from keyboard/joystick by device word and setup slot team

name: PullGoalie
evidence: called per team from HandleSlotButtons on goalie pull bit; edits team struct (0x136 bytes)

name: PlaybackInputRecord
evidence: called by the timer instead of recording when playback flag bit0 set

name: SlotButtons
evidence: the 4 slot button dwords of the current frame

name: SlotTable
evidence: 4 entries x 7 bytes: on byte, device word, buttons dword

name: InputPlaybackFlags
evidence: bit0: input comes from a recording

name: LineChangeReq
evidence: per team (2 words): line change requested
